messages:
Sam: Quick sync — Q4 hosted API capacity planning. Need to decide buy vs lease mix, APAC region shortfall, and whether to push some steady-state load to on-prem pilot. I uploaded the preliminary forecast to the shared drive. Thoughts?

Lina: Saw the forecast. Short version: APAC expected +45% token hours in Q4 due to new partner launch. Global peak concurrency shifts +12% in Nov. We have ~420k GPU hours cushion in US but only ~80k in APAC.

Mohammed: Do we have vendor lead times for bare-metal buys in APAC? last time it was 8-10 weeks for delivery + customs. Leasing could be faster but ~25% higher unit cost.

Claire: Budget FYI — we have room for incremental OPEX (~$400k) this quarter but CAPEX spend needs exec sign-off. If we can show 6-9 month ROI on buys vs leases it helps.

Jules: Can we push lower-priority workloads to Dedicated reserved capacity or schedule heavier batching at off-peak local hours in APAC to shave peak? That may reduce immediate capacity needs by ~10-15%.

Lina: Quick data snippet from the forecast (peak day estimate):
```
region  req_gpu_hours_weekly  peak_gpus_needed
US      120000              420
APAC    54000               170
EU      70000               210
```
We assume 70% utilization for bought fleet baseline.

Sam: Options on the table: (A) Short-term 6-month leases for APAC burst + buy US capacity now. (B) Larger buy in APAC (requires CAPEX OK, risky due to customs/time). (C) Hybrid: buy minimal APAC nodes + burst via cloud-leases in peak weeks. Which is everyone leaning to?

Mohammed: For lead time risk I'd push hybrid (C). Also suggest a vendor RFP to get multiple lease quotes — we can try to lock pricing with shorter SLA tiers for cost savings.

infra-bot: Reminder: Procurement ticket INF-582 created and linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-582 (Assignee: Mohammed)

Claire: Hybrid makes sense given budget constraints. Mohammed — please get 3 lease quotes and one buy quote from vendors in APAC. Include Customs/duties in the total landed cost.

Jules: Also, before finalizing, can Eng Runtime run a small experiment to quantify gains from increasing batching/windowing for APAC traffic? If batching reduces GPU-hours by >8% it's a big lever.

Lina: Will schedule the batching experiement with @runtime-team. If results look good we can reduce the planned burst scale. Timeline: need vendor decisions by 2 weeks to hit Nov delivery window for leases.

Sam: Okay — action items: Mohammed: RFP + landed cost breakdown (due EOW). Jules: run batching experiment (results in 7 days). Lina: update forecast with experiment assumptions. Claire: prep CAPEX ask if buy is recommended. We’ll reconvene next Tue at 11am PT. :thumbsup:
